== Course of events ==

This event marks the return of Toto together with Dorothy. It took place as Dorothy came back to the house, at the moment when Aunt Em, who was watering the cabbages outside, saw Dorothy running toward her — the return of Toto coincided with this arrival, the two of them coming back together.

In the moments that followed, Dorothy expressed how glad she was to be home again, and she told Aunt Em that she had come from the Land of Oz, situating Toto's return with her as the close of that journey and the resumption of her life at home.
